cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
  project(perception_compare_native VERSION 3.0.0 LANGUAGES CXX)
  include(CTest)
endif()
find_package(OpenCV REQUIRED COMPONENTS core imgproc imgcodecs)
get_filename_component(_compare_root "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../.." ABSOLUTE)
file(READ "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/compare_viewer.html" COMPARE_VIEWER_TEMPLATE)
configure_file("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/viewer_template.hpp.in" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/viewer_template.hpp" @ONLY)
add_library(perception_compare_native STATIC src/orchestrator.cpp src/report.cpp src/viewer.cpp src/version_check.cpp src/sha256.cpp src/disparity_compare.cpp)
target_compile_features(perception_compare_native PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(perception_compare_native PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include"
  PRIVATE "${_compare_root}/scheduling/config/include" "${_compare_root}/scheduling/dag/include"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}" ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_link_libraries(perception_compare_native PRIVATE ${OpenCV_LIBS})
target_compile_options(perception_compare_native PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
add_executable(r36_compare src/main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(r36_compare PRIVATE perception_compare_native)
if(NOT DEFINED R36_COMPARE_INSTALL_DESTINATION)
  set(R36_COMPARE_INSTALL_DESTINATION lib/perception_ros_so_demo)
endif()
install(TARGETS r36_compare RUNTIME DESTINATION "${R36_COMPARE_INSTALL_DESTINATION}")
option(R36_NATIVE_COMPARE_TESTS "Build native recording/report contract tests" ${BUILD_TESTING})
if(R36_NATIVE_COMPARE_TESTS)
  enable_testing()
  add_executable(native_compare_contract_test tests/contracts.cpp)
  target_compile_features(native_compare_contract_test PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
  target_include_directories(native_compare_contract_test PRIVATE "${_compare_root}/scheduling/config/include"
    "${_compare_root}/scheduling/dag/include" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src" ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS})
  target_link_libraries(native_compare_contract_test PRIVATE perception_compare_native ${OpenCV_LIBS})
  add_test(NAME native_compare_contract COMMAND native_compare_contract_test "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/contract-output")
  add_executable(native_crop_compare_contract_test tests/crop_contracts.cpp)
  target_compile_features(native_crop_compare_contract_test PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
  target_include_directories(native_crop_compare_contract_test PRIVATE "${_compare_root}/scheduling/config/include"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src" ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS})
  target_link_libraries(native_crop_compare_contract_test PRIVATE perception_compare_native ${OpenCV_LIBS})
  add_dependencies(native_crop_compare_contract_test r36_compare)
  add_test(NAME native_crop_compare_contract COMMAND native_crop_compare_contract_test
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/contract-output" "$<TARGET_FILE:r36_compare>")
endif()
